newsitem.title: USA: Weyco to build distribution facility.
newsitem.headline: Weyco to build distribution facility.

text.p: Weyco Group Inc said a new distribution facility to support its growing wholesale business is scheduled to open July 1, 1998 in Glendale, Wis. Construction is to begin this summer.

Between 1993 and 1996, wholesale shipments increased more than 40 percent, Weyco said. The new facility will house corporate offices as well a consolidate warehousing and distribution of Nunn Bush, Brass Boot and Stacy Adams brands.
Earlier Wednesday, the company reported first-quarter earnings of $1.50 per share, up from $1.10. Sales were $34,153,000, compared with $34,172,000 in the 1996 period.

Sales in the wholesale division rose two percent, although the increase was offset by a 23 percent decline in retail sales as a result of the closing of 13 leased departments in 1996. Same-store retail sales in the remaining 16 stores were up 17 percent for the quarter.
